description: This file defines the EmployeeReportController class, a PHP controller for handling employee report pages within the OrangeHRM system. It manages report data retrieval and component rendering logic.

classes.name: EmployeeReportController
classes.description: Controller class for managing employee report views, either listing reports or showing specific report details.

methods.name: getReportGeneratorService
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns an instance of ReportGeneratorService.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares and sets the Vue component to render based on whether a specific report ID is provided in the request.
